youtube_short.title: Your Debit Card Has Zero Fraud Protection
title_alternatives: The Hidden Truth About Your Debit Card
Why You Should Never Use a Debit Card
youtube_short.description: Nobody tells you this when you sign up for a debit card: credit cards and debit cards are covered by completely different fraud protection laws. Federal law caps your credit card fraud liability at exactly zero dollars. With debit, if you report fraud within 2 days you owe $50 max — but wait past 60 days and your bank can legally keep every penny that was stolen. Meanwhile your account gets frozen for up to 10 business days during their investigation, while your rent, food, and utilities are still due. The fix is simple: use a credit card for all purchases, pay it in full every month, and only touch your debit card at the ATM. Follow for more money traps your bank doesn't want you to know. #personalfinance #debitcard #creditcard #moneytips #bankingtips #financialliteracy

hook_line: Your debit card has zero fraud protection
